# Dkit

Self-hosted secrets manager for side projects: env vars per environment,
injected into processes at runtime (no .env on disk), human-readable cron that
fires HTTP calls, uptime monitors with email alerts, a log drain, and a JSON
key-value store. One Express backend serves the API, the React dashboard and
the docs. A `dkit` CLI talks to the same API.

Site: https://dkit.name.ng
Docs: https://dkit.name.ng/docs
Status: https://dkit.name.ng/status
Changelog: https://dkit.name.ng/changelog
Source: https://github.com/sera0x/Dkit
License: MIT

Install the CLI:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sera0x/Dkit/main/install.sh | sh
```

or `npm install -g dkit-cli`.

Self-host it with Node 18+, PostgreSQL and Redis: clone the repo, fill
`backend/.env` from `backend/.env.example` (three required values), run
`./scripts/start.sh`. The API and dashboard come up on port 3001.
